message: `/etc/passwd` is a file path, not a module-path segment
label: a module-path segment is a name: `/` is not part of one
notes: a segment carrying `/` re-anchors the search directory it is concatenated onto, so the import resolves outside the project
help: write the module's dotted name - `Sys.Platform`, not `Sys/Platform` - and put the directory holding it on `AXIOM_PATH` or beside the entry file; a module name is resolved against the search directories, never used as a path of its own
